name: Montage
description: Give Montage a URL or a Google Drive link and it pulls the video in and watches the import until it's done. From there, ask for a moment. It cuts the clip and replies with an editor link, so you can trim it or fix the styling before you post it anywhere.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Montage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Montage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.montage.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Montage MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Montage lists 13 MCP tools, including create_moment, create_playbook, get_moments, get_playbook, get_project, get_transcript, get_upload_status, get_video_corpus, get_workflow_status, list_playbooks, list_projects, and update_playbook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Montage?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Montage in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
Montage requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Montage is developed by Montage. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
